top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single part on GLP-1 physiology to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The discovery chain (human incretin physiology, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology) explains why a whole drug class works, and its glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal effects are replicated in large independent outcome trials over about two decades, so maturity is not in doubt. Allocating to the discovery biology rather than the analogue engineering is defensible, and the citation says the discoveries made the therapies possible. The weak point is Mojsov's priority relative to Habener, which I cannot resolve from the supplied material, but it does not outweigh awarding a mature, clearly changed field over no award.
